checkpoints.name: MiniMax H3

The CFG-distilled base model generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 768-pixel short side, 50 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3. checkpoints.name: Qwen Image 1.0 (BF16, Exact)
